notes.subject: מגן
notes.rationale: מגן em i 'sein' (banis bilong pait); ol tanim tok i putim 'man i gatstrong/bainat' — som man i ritim olsem 'man i kari sein'.

notes.subject: lek
notes.rationale: Tanim tok bilong מחסרך i bruk — 'samting i no stap bilong yu' i tambu long bagarapim nem bilong ves 11, em i token {ומחסרך} yet.

translation: na po man i kamap long yu olsem man i wokabaut long rot, na lek bilong yu olsem man i holim bainat.

tokens.gloss: olsem man i wokabaut long rot
na samting i no stap bilong yu
